notes.title: Karate Survivor is out now!
notes.content:
Are you ready to unleash your inner martial arts master? Karate Survivor is live, ready to throw you into the gritty, fast-paced world of 80s street brawls! 

In this survivor-like roguelite, every corner of the city is your battleground. Fend off relentless thugs using fists, feet, and anything you can get your hands on – from mop handles to plastic flamingos! Your surroundings are part of your arsenal. Push over scaffolding, swing microwave doors, and turn the world into a weapon. 

[previewyoutube=WH_KjiLuvMg;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What awaits you in Karate Survivor: [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Improvised Combat:[/b] Use whatever you can get your hands on to dismantle your enemies. Even a toy hammer can be lethal! 
[*][b] Environmental Warfare: [/b]Manipulate the streets to your advantage. Push objects at enemies, bring down scaffolding, or slam them with a microwave door. 
[*] [b]Dynamic Combos: [/b]Mix and match dozens of attacks into unique six-move combos. Find the most devastating combos to suit your style. 
[*] [b]Progression and Mastery: [/b]Unlock and master techniques that stay with you across runs. Every fight brings you closer to martial arts mastery. 
[*] [b]Fast-paced Runs and Boss Battles: [/b]Face fierce bosses across gritty locations in epic, high-speed showdowns. 
[/list]
Also, we’ll be adding a new challenge mode as a New Game+ with increased difficulty in an upcoming post-release patch for those eager to test their skills. 

Stay tuned and grab Karate Survivor now with a 10% launch discount. Don’t forget to leave a review to support us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

notes.title: Technotopia is Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Technotopia, a game developed by Yustas and published by Alawar, is now available on Windows and macOS![/b] The city of the future awaits, and it’s your time to take control. 

As the AI Iris, you are tasked with creating the perfect city in a world fractured by social and economic unrest. The metropolis teeters on the edge of chaos, and the balance between competing factions is fragile. Every decision you make will shape the fate of Technotopia – will you build a utopia, or let the city descend into turmoil? 

[previewyoutube=8ZPQsLAHWfg;full][/previewyoutube]

What awaits you in Technotopia: 

[list]
[*] 4 Faction-Driven Questlines: Capitalists, aristocrats, politicians, and common citizens all want control of the city. Navigate their conflicting agendas and choose your allies wisely – each storyline will alter the city’s future. 
[*] 100+ Unique Buildings: Construct skyscrapers, parks, residential zones, and industrial hubs. Every building you place will influence the balance of power, helping or hindering different factions. Strategically combine city blocks to maximize efficiency and unlock special bonuses. 
[*] 50+ Dynamic Events: From everyday mishaps to faction conflicts, every event in Technotopia is shaped by your choices, with consequences that ripple across the city. 
[*] Factions' Influence: Every decision shifts the delicate balance between the city’s ruling groups. Will you appease the elites, or side with the people? 
[*] City News & Criminal Activity: As crime rises, new challenges emerge, forcing you to make tough decisions. Stay informed through real-time news reports that reflect the impact of your actions on the city's order. 
[/list]
Get the game with a [b]10% launch[/b] discount and share your feedback on Technotopia – we’re excited to hear your thoughts! Join our Discord to stay up to date on the latest news. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825110/Technotopia/

notes.title: Necroking is now available!
notes.content:
Necroking has officially emerged from the shadows and is now live on Windows and macOS! 

The world is crumbling under chaos. Cities are rotting and the living dare to stand in your way. But fear not, because you are the Necroking – master of the undead, wielder of dark magic, and bringer of doom. It’s time to raise your army and show the world what real power looks like! 

[previewyoutube=mZ1W5iGz0MU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What awaits you in Necroking:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Become the Death Monarch.[/b] Command over 30 unique undead minions and crush anyone who stands against you. 
[*] [b]Vast Skull Deckbuilding. [/b]Customize your deck, unlock powerful unites, and devastate your enemies. 
[*] [b]4 diverse biomes.[/b] Each with its own deadly challenges and unique bosses. 
[*] [b]King’s Secret. [/b]Unravel the mystery of the King as you journey through a dark, twisted story. 
[/list]
You can already play Necroking on Steam Deck using the trackpads, and we’re hard at work on adding full controller and Steam Deck support in upcoming updates. Stay tuned and join our [url=https://discord.gg/alawar]Discord[/url] server to keep up with all the news!

Get the game with a 10% launch discount and leave feedback on Necroking – we can’t wait to hear what you think: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2852980/Necroking/

notes.title: Watchers is available FOR FREE!
notes.content:
The Rescue Operation Center presents: a top-down battle royale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1124980/Watchers/?utm_source=cp&utm_medium=dtr&utm_campaign=sh&utm_content=r

To die in Watchers isn't equal to lose. After death on the battlefield, you become a watcher and have the power to influence the events.

[b]If you are a battler:[/b]
[list]
[*] Loot your neighbors' houses to find the coolest weapons
[*] Eliminate opponents to win a Royal victory
[*] And if you fail to reach the end — become a watcher!
[/list]

[b]In watcher mode:[/b]
[list]
[*] Choose your favorite and help him win
[*] Destroy opponents with deadly experiments
[*] Give hints with the help of reactions and sprays
[/list]

https://youtu.be/hwxqweXmI6o

Over.

notes.title: Attention all polar survivors!
notes.content:
Over the last day, our Rescue Operation Center has received many urgent messages. 

[b]We would like to inform you about the following updates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Many of you felt the pain of loss when you couldn’t inject adrenaline into an unconscious partner after entering the next zone. Now you will be able to save him/her!
[*]Electric anomalies ignored your traps. The electrician from the neighborhood base agreed to repair the welding of trap cables for a cup of hot coffee, so from now on the traps should work just fine.
[*]We talked sense into Emil Gustav. Now his presence on the map doesn’t cause graphic artifacts.
[*]Our polar explorers are super pros, but they are not omnipotent. This is why from now on they will not be able to loot bags with items removed from the inventory through the walls.
[*]Now a character killed by the red anomaly will always look into the face of his/her murderer.
[*]The map now shows workbenches for tool repairs so it is more convenient for our polar explorers to find them.
[*]Sometimes the base generated places where characters couldn’t go. We got rid of these places.
[*]All entrance doors will be highlighted regardless of power in the building.
[*]We fixed the quest with three heavy bags and a supply platform: now bags will not disappear and you will always be able to load the platform to come to the next zone.
[*]We added an error message when a saved file is corrupted. It will rescue you from freezing when loading the game!
[*]Now you will not hear any extraneous noises during pause, only ominous silence.
[*]We improved the translation of in-game texts.
[/list]

We are standing by for messages about abnormal incidents and will react swiftly!

Over and out.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28830244/00f8b8804807a39b4fac3c4e368e4ab33c610431.png[/img]

notes.title: Emergency Message!
notes.content:
Rescue Operation Center has decided to send additional resources to the base. Due to poor weather conditions, the helicopter won’t land; instead we are going to execute a cargo drop. The package that you’ll receive contains:

[b]BALANCE SECTION[/b]
[list]
[*]The frequency of getting madnesses is lowered. Now you can search for a bed a bit longer, but don’t waste this time because without sleep a survivor will still eventually go nuts.
[*]Madness treatment terms are adjusted. One madness can be cured over a 30-second uninterrupted sleep (previously it required 60-second uninterrupted sleep). Now one can cure 2 madnesses over a 60-second uninterrupted sleep.
[*]The survivors’ stats (warmth, stamina and safety) decrease slower. Now you have a few additional seconds to open a door or to fight anomalies.
[*]The number of beds in each zone is increased. We’ve made it easier for both you and the anomalies :-)
[*]The survivors have gotten more attentive and careful. Now they cut themselves less often, while the number of bandages on the base remains the same. 
[*]The survivors have also improved their skills. Now it takes less time to complete routine tasks such as digging and opening the doors.
[/list]

[u][i]IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RANDOM GENERATION:[/i][/u]
We ensure that every randomly generated base has everything you need to survive. Indeed, sometimes the required tools or medicine will be in some distant building or locked in a box, and sometimes you will be able to find them quickly and easily. Random generation only affects the location of the objects. The list of what you can find always remains the same.

[b]TECH ISSUES SECTION[/b]
[list]
 [*]Fixed the bug where you couldn’t change the view angle and the survivors wouldn’t move. If you run into this bug again, simply save the game and then load this save. 
[*]Decreased memory usage to make the game stable when launched on a slow computer.
[*]Fixed several bugs that lead to freezing and crashes.
[/list]

[b]OTHER ISSUES SECTION[/b]
[list]
 [*]The armored door now explodes with an appropriate explosion sound.
[*]A dozen other small but necessary changes that make the game smoother.
[/list]

The helicopter is on its way to the base! Expect arrival in just a few minutes!
Over.


[img]https://image.ibb.co/csbd45/01.png[/img]
